reviews.title: Requires subscription
reviews.text: Requires a subscription. Not interested in renting an app

reviews.title: Free version is useless, actual functionality is blocked by paywall
reviews.text: They’ve put every single useful part of the app behind a paywall. The only things you have access to in the free version is the quiz to find out if baby is ready and infant and toddler choking rescue guides. Every single other aspect of the app is locked unless you pay $100/year or $20/mo (which is in itself absolutely absurd pricing). Charge for the entire app at this point so people like me don’t waste their time and storage space. Paywalls have ruined so much of the app and internet space.

reviews.title: Looked good but totally let me down.
reviews.text: It didn’t do what it was saying on the advert. Constant trying to get me to start the 7 day trial. Big AI personalisation which just makes the app hard to check out. It’s £75 for the year to get the info you actually want which could easily be googled.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: Not free

reviews.title: Impossible to delete account!
reviews.text: If you want to have a permanent account with your baby’s data, this is the app for you.

reviews.title: Don’t do the “free” trial
reviews.text: It says you can cancel anytime during the free trial but then they make impossible. Charged my card $109 for a year subscription and won’t answer their emails. I emailed them before my card was even charged and got only an AI response that someone would be in touch. That was a week ago now.

reviews.title: Subscription Pricing and Paywall
reviews.text: The app seems super helpful but everything is behind a subscription wall. It would be nice if there was a bit more access on the free version. Paying $20 a month seems a bit high. Most apps with subscriptions are still able to be used without or are very clear that you need to pay to use. This one doesn’t even allow basic tracking of what your baby has tried.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: Requires a $100/yr subscription. This is not disclosed until after you create an account, give them your email, and give them your child’s name and age. Apple should pull this app for collecting personal info before disclosing that payment is required.

reviews.title: Sub needed for basically the whole app
reviews.text: Found this really frustrating- everything i needed to know was extra and would only be unlocked with a subscription. Could’ve been a 5 star app if literally anything other than the CPR videos and generic food information was available.  This app is fine if you’re looking to add another subscription to your life but i was very disappointed.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I guess  was hoping the app would help make it easy to feed my family and my baby and make less work overall for me. It’s not like that. You can’t really plug in the dish you want to make and get a baby family version with chocking and nnutirion advice for baby. It’s good for about the 6-9 mth hump tells you how to cut stuff. But don’t expect it will provide much benefit after. Its really gonna come down to your creativity. You not gonna have what the app calls for on hand so it’s an extra step to make dinner off their recipes not accessible food. Culturally your family may not respond to the recipes. Lots of room for improvement. Maybe just pay a couple mths when starting off definitely don’t waste money continuing. It’s literally solid starts not for nutrition after.

reviews.title: Now everything has a paywall
reviews.text: Lifetime subscription my behind!!! I paid for this in 2023 for a “lifetime subscription” and now every feature I want to use is paywalled. You guys are greedy and I’ll never use your app again.

reviews.title: Predatory Charges
reviews.text:
I signed up for a subscription to test out the app. Shortly after I forgot about the 7 day trial. A week later it auto set me up with an annual plan and charged me £74.99.
I’m sick of developers scamming customers like this - let us try the app without forcing charges - its awful practice and shows you have no respect for those looking for help feeding babies. Shame on you. Write what you want in your response and spin it whatever way you want - you should do better.

reviews.title: Multiple Paywalls
reviews.text: Had to this app for awhile mainly using the “how to serve” but recently they’ve added yet ANOTHER paywall which deems this app completely useless. Having to pay for a simple google search is actually crazy. I hope the developers rethink making people pay for safe ways to serve food. Sad i have to part with this app but won’t pay for another subscription for something i can google for free.

reviews.title: No Point
reviews.text: There’s really no point in having this app unless if you’re willing to pay for it. You get no access to marking things as favorites or that your little one tried a food, the guides are locked except for a few, and every recipe is locked. I heard this was such a good resource to have and that the paid version isn’t necessary, but turns out, in order to have said resources, you have to pay.

reviews.title: Can’t use without paying.
reviews.text: This app would be great if it wasn’t $100. They get you by showing you all the things you can do with it but you can do nothing without paying as if everything for your baby didn’t already cost enough. Just charge up front instead of the sneaky nonsense.

reviews.title: Not accessible with screen readers for the blind
reviews.text:
Please could you kindly work on your app, so that it is accessible with screen readers so that blind parents can take full advantage as well?
Thank you very much.

I have tried to troubleshoot the problem by logging out and deleting the app, but the videos still aren’t playing. Nothing happens when I click on them. I have to use the web version to get any of the videos to work.

reviews.title: Price change

reviews.title: £20 a month

reviews.title: Way overpriced for what you get
reviews.text: I never write reviews, but today when again I couldn’t find a basic food in their database I felt forced to write this review! This app charges 100!!! $ a year and doesn’t have a database of many many foods, forcing me to google most of the foods I feed my daughter anyways, so I might as well not have the app altogether. Additionally it does not let you create your own meals for the baby so you can add those easily to the log. I think a huge part of BLW is that babies eat at the family table and get introduced to “adult” foods in a save manner, but good luck finding those in the app… the only reason I give 2 stars over 1 is that their customer service is very nice and helpful

reviews.title: Don’t waste your time

Have to force close and open again to use the app. Also, there’s no way to print a recipe. I mean, who would want to print a recipe when they could get their phone dirty while cooking? reviews.title: Didn’t Save Progress

reviews.title: Terrible app

reviews.title: PLEASE FIX THE CONSTANT SIGN OUT ISSUES

Also, when attempting to troubleshoot this issue repeatedly, the only way to back out of the system that tries to force you into making a new account is to completed delete the app and redownload so you can try again with a different combo. reviews.title: Not intuitive

If there is an option to do this its not easily found.

reviews.title: Expensive

reviews.title: Subscription Required

reviews.title: Disappointed in the changes

The app and all the videos on instagram helped me navigate the process of feeding my little one and I raved about it to my friends. Fast forward to 2026 and I’m starting my new baby’s feeding journey and I’m incredibly disappointed by how little content is available without a subscription. The videos and recipes that were formerly free are now not available without a subscription.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I'm so disappointed regarding the cost. I used this daily with my first child to ease anxiety around serving food. I physically cannot afford now I'm maternity.

reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.text: I think it’s such a shame how expensive this app is for new parents who are on maternity leave and on reduced incomes. I can’t justify the price. I thought it would be a really helpful app at an exciting time for my baby’s development, but it’s just out to make money which is really disappointing.

reviews.title: THIS APP IS A NIGHTMARE!
reviews.text:
It’s such a shame that this app can not get it together! The information is amazing but the app itself is AWFUL! I can’t remember the last time I used it because every time I would try to it would just crash. I ended up cancelling my subscription and guess what? THEY STILL TRIED TO CHARGE ME. Now it says I basically have to pay to cancel. Ridiculous. And the customer service? Nowhere to be found, yet the Instagram is fully active making posts and replying to comments. 
You’re better off just googling the information rather than using this app.

reviews.title: Money Hungry
reviews.text: I hate to say I feel that way, but I do. I decided to buy the book first when I saw anything of use in the app would cost money to unlock and unfortunately the book has minimal useful information and instead, repeatedly refers you to their app. The thing is, so many of us new moms are so worried about doing solids right, that as outrageous as $100 a year is, I’ll pay it for the peace of mind for my child. It just doesn’t feel good or ethical to be charging what they are and seemingly cutting off access to a whole demographic because they can’t afford it.

reviews.title: Trial Cancelled - Still Charged
reviews.text: I did the 7-day trial and requested to cancel the same day. 7 days went by and I was charged. Attempted to get a refund and was denied.

reviews.title: Login required - why?
reviews.text:
1. The app first asks users if it’s a “five star experience.” if yes, it directs them to give a review here on the App Store. If not, it directs them to a website to write feedback privately. This warps ratings.

2. Login required. Absolutely no reason other than selling your info for marketing.

reviews.title: Expensive

I just downloaded it to use with my second and can not believe the price of it now. I understand they say there’s more to it, but I don’t need all the extras. If this is the reason for such a ridiculous price increase then there should be different levels of subscriptions available with different prices.

reviews.title: They just take your money!
reviews.text: I used this app maybe 2-3 times during the trial and thought I had cancelled it. Turns out I had forgot.. so you can imagine when I got my little maternity money they took out £100 it was a lot!! I contacted Apple and they’ve decided they’re not refunding me even if it leaves me short. I cancelled the subscription straight away. Apparently they don’t care. 😮‍💨 I won’t be using the app at all! Sorry but £100 for people who are on maternity leave is wild.

reviews.title: Very expensive
reviews.text: I used this 3 years ago with my daughter and sure I paid £8.99 for the year. Recommended it to loads of people. Just started weaning my second and it’s now £20 a month! Definitely too much considering the people using it are most likely on maternity leave with little to no income. You have even now remove the larger images of how to serve. I get you want to make money but it just greed now. I’m sure many more people would subscribe if it was cheaper. I know I would.

reviews.title: Paywalls
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a free source this would not be totally it. Yes there is some good info in this app but a GIANT portion of it is hidden by pay walls and I’m not paying $20 a month for an app as IMO that’s pretty expensive.

*RESPONSE* I’m well aware of X-ing out and navigating the database, you’re not understanding that in order to gain access to MANY other things in this app, including  being able to click options under “meals with this ingredient”, being able to watch a video of preparation or how to feed to a baby - that it’s behind a paywall and the paywall isn’t super reasonably priced. $100 for the year or $20 a month is crazy. I don’t even spend $20 a month for any of my subscription apps including streaming apps. If the app was tiered better, and the monthly cost was so high I’d actually consider subscribing. You’re not listening to everyone when they are making you aware of the out of touch price point. All you do is tell them the food database is free and to just ignore when the app is telling you “hey you have to pay to access this”……

reviews.title: Very expensive now
reviews.text:
Used this with my first child just over 2 years ago and it cost maybe £5-6 a month? It was invaluable then, especially as a first time mother. My youngest has started weaning and I just wanted to remind myself of how to serve some things and track what foods he’s tried but it’s more than 10x the price!! And whilst the “how to serve” function is free, the app is so paywalled that you can’t even search a food without it popping up several times asking about subscribing. I also can’t seem to find an easy way to track the food without it doing the same despite that supposedly being free. I can see there’s a lot more guidance and guides etc now which is probably fantastic advice for new mums and I can see why it justifies the price (sort of!) however it feels remiss to not have different layers of membership for those of us not actually needing that! Or at the very least not having the annoying pop up to get you to subscribe every time you try to search for a food! 

Safe to say I won’t be using it this time.

reviews.title: Baby-Led Weaning only
reviews.text:
I reached out to support and they claim their app isn't only baby-led weaning, but it is what they recommend you do. Even their purée recipes say to let your baby feed themselves. They emailed me and said it was ultimately my decision, but their way is the best way. There are recipes for purées hence the 2 stars, but I wish they were more forthcoming in their approach for new moms. 

I wish I could get my money back.

reviews.title: Dangerous! DO NOT USE!
reviews.text:
I’d give 0 stars if I could. The information on this app is incredibly dangerous and the serving suggestions pose SERIOUS CHOKING HAZARDS. A few examples are grapes (the app suggests halved from 12m and then whole, but should be quartered until the age of 5), broccoli (it doesn’t tell you to quarter the stems lengthways to remove roundness) and chicken (it doesn’t tell you what size the pieces should actually be).
PLEASE DO NOT USE THIS DANGEROUS APP!

reviews.title: Waste of Time
reviews.text: This app makes you create an account and profile for you and your baby, makes you answer a lot of questions, promises a lot of stuff, and then tells you that you have to pay a monthly or yearly subscription to use pretty much anything on the app. For one, this is ridiculous because you’re only going to use this app for a few months or maybe a year at most and then your baby will be eating regular food exactly how you make it anyway so this app will be useless then so obviously they’re just trying to get you to forget you have the subscription so they can keep taking your money even after you no longer need this app. For two, there is absolutely no reason to make people go through the whole process of creating accounts and profiles when you can do pretty much nothing without paying. Why not just tell people up front that they have to pay? It’s such a waste of time. After going through the account and profile making process, I can’t even mark if my child has tried a food or not without making an account. This app sounds like a great idea but sadly the people who need it most aren’t going to have access to it because the price is ridiculous and you can’t even do basic things without paying for the app. Don’t bother downloading this app. I’m sure there are free apps that will at least let you do the basics of what this app does which is all you need.

reviews.title: Helpful information horrible functionality
reviews.text: The information this app provides is wonderful.  The articles are helpful, the instructions on how to prepare different foods safely give me peace of mind, and the guidance on introducing allergens made it much less scary.  BUT, the functionality of this app is absolute trash.  When I try to add a meal to the tracker, it always logs it for the following day and I have to manually go in and individually change every ingredient to the correct day—it’s infuriating!  The allergen introduction feature also just stopped working for me after pistachio.  Usually when you complete an allergen, the next one pops up for you to start, but the app just stopped working once we hit pistachio.  I hate the meal planning feature, and I dislike that you need to complete these other modules (like dip and bite) before it will give you instructions on the next allergen.  Why can’t I just go into the allergen list, click one, and get the instructions and meals for introducing that allergen??  Logging foods is so annoying that I just stopped using the feature after a few weeks.  I will also say this app is very white and has little to no information on many of the Chinese vegetables we consume.  Lastly, the recipes on the app are not good and I did not enjoy any of the ones we tried that are designed to be shared by the whole family.  TLDR:  useful for allergen introduction (as long as the app is working) and for checking how to safely prepare a food (as long as it’s a mainstream food), and not much

reviews.title: So frustrating to use
reviews.text:
UPDATED TO INCLUDE MORE INFO:
As other reviewers have said, a feature to track how long it’s been since my baby had a certain food would be very handy for allergens.
The “my next meals” carousel is constantly recommending meals that we’ve already tried. And it even says they’ve been tried! So why are they being suggested again? When I try to mark them as tried so they go away, it marks it as tried today, but we didn’t try it today so I’m not trying to track it like that. So annoying. 
Under the Plan feature you can only plan meals not just foods. I really don’t care about the meals feature and don’t use that. I just want to be able to look at my calendar and know what my plan is for which foods on which days. I don’t want things like olive oil or seasonings automatically added.
This app is awful. It crashes all the time, and I’m constantly led to dead ends with links. The app routes me to the website only to ask me to purchase the app - I HAVE!! So frustrating and hard to use. 0/10. Stay away.

reviews.title: Frustrating , lots of glitches
reviews.text:
This app needs work. 1- you can only progress in one section of food at at time. So one week you’re eating a ton of beans, the next a ton of fruit, the next a ton of herbs. It would be nice if you could work on multiple at once. 2- it doesn’t save your food sometimes , yes I have tried deleting and re installing. 3- most frustrating. You choose your foods for the week and then it gives you recipes. But if you don’t click that you tried the recipe (which has other ingredients) the it will not give you credit for eating the food. Example you just give your kiddo rice , click that they tried rice, but then you don’t click that they tried the “coconut rice” recipe. Then it acts as though you haven’t tried rice. 

There are some helpful parts like how to serve what food but the frustrations outweigh the help

reviews.title: Useful Content, Frustrating and Inflexible App
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for a while, and while some parts are useful—like basic tracking and meal suggestions—it is not user-friendly. The app frequently fails to update, and there’s no way to manually enter, edit, or correct information. You also can’t add foods your baby has tried unless they already exist in the app, which makes it feel very limited and not truly customizable.

I’m currently working on the scoop-and-mash stage and have no way to record that my child is scooping and mashing different foods—the app simply won’t allow it. I’ve also attempted to start peanut allergen tracking twice, but the app didn’t save it and won’t let me add the allergen manually.

Overall, the lack of flexibility and basic functionality is extremely frustrating, especially for a paid app. For the cost, I expected something far more intuitive and adaptable. I don’t think it’s worth purchasing—using the free version or trying a different app is probably a better option.

reviews.title: Don’t fall for ‘free’ trial
reviews.text: I downloaded this app after hearing lots of positive reviews and signed up for the seven day trial with a view to potentially keeping the subscription for maybe a couple of months if it proved useful. I’m on day seven which should be the last day of my free trial and I’ve already been charged for an entire year. Why not call it a six day trial if that’s what you’re actually offering? Seems like they’re trying to catch people out. I can’t afford £99 and now I’m in financial trouble just for trying to care for my baby. Absolutely disgusting. If anyone is thinking of trying this, cancel your subscription IMMEDIATELY to make sure they can’t scam you too. Or better yet, stick with the free version. App seems fine other than that. It’s basically just a list of foods you can select when baby has tried them.

reviews.title: The price is over the roof!
reviews.text: I used this app with my first daughter 2 years ago and been recommending it to everyone since. Was about to renew my membership as my youngest is approaching the weaning phase and was shocked to find out that the price is now 10x!!! I used to pay somewhere between £2-£3 a month for it and now it’s £20! Not sure what justifies such jump in price?! Definitely not worth it, especially now with chatgpt and similar sites. What a shame. Won’t be coming back and won’t be recommending anymore.

reviews.title: Buggy, feels sloppily made
reviews.text: Constant loading dials in random spots. An example of the feel of this app, when you click on a food, for some reason it has a profile logo next to the food name title. When you click on that, it loads your profile info behind the food window. I didn’t see anywhere else an access to my profile so seems to be in an odd place. In the same food window there’s options like “how to serve” and “choking” and “allergens” but nothing comes up. Not to mention when I first downloaded and finished signing up, it had me choose boy, girl, or prefer not to say. It didn’t freeze, just choosing an option didn’t move me forward. I had to close out of app and reopen it. I’m not going to even risk forgetting about free trial ending with an app this buggy. $20/mo is pretty steep with what it’s meant to offer even without the issues.

reviews.title: Not worth the cost
reviews.text:
This app was highly recommended and I HATE it. The information itself is good available in the free version - such as how to serve a certain food. But the technology is terrible. 

For example - whenever I log my baby’s dinner after he is in bed (around 8 pm) it ALWAYS logs it in the following day. I have to manually change every ingredient used. I have problem solved this such as checking to see if my time in the app was wrong or anything like that but nope. 

Another example - The app doesn’t “talk to itself”. I introduced foods a certain way recommended by the pediatrician such as peanuts early. I logged these items as food on the day tried, and again I did trouble-shoot this issue so have double checked they are logged in the app. However when I use the progress feature in the app the allergens are not listed. This is because I didn’t log them in the specific way under “allergens”. 

Overall - it is not an organized way to track your baby’s food. Only purchase if planning to use it as a tool for picking recipes and meal planning but even then already know how and what you want to introduce to baby. I much prefer Huckleberry for logging the solids and I also already use to app to log sleep and diapers. This is coming from a FTM with a baby who had food allergies and logs everything. 

This is my first review of an app ever and it’s because I hate I wasted my money on it when with a baby money is tight.
